verdict.rationale: Databricks ships AI features such as Genie Code, AI Gateway and model services, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a policy or setting that keeps customer data out of AI model training. AI Gateway guardrails, Unity Catalog access control and SOC 2 attestations are related governance controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
